question: Which paper reports the cryptic ferrofluid bandit catalyst stability result?
expected_answer_points: ferrofluid bandit catalyst remains stable under pulsed salinity

candidate_papers.title: Graphene aerogel transport notes
candidate_papers.text: A graphene aerogel study measured ordinary conductivity drift in dry cells. It does not discuss ferrofluid bandit catalysts or salinity pulses.

candidate_papers.title: Cryptic ferrofluid bandit catalyst stability
candidate_papers.text: The cryptic ferrofluid bandit catalyst remains stable under pulsed salinity. The hidden target paper reports no collapse after the stress cycle.

candidate_papers.title: Contextual bandit policy survey
candidate_papers.text: This survey covers contextual bandit policies for recommendation systems and omits catalyst stability evidence.

candidate_papers.title: Salinity sensor calibration
candidate_papers.text: A calibration note about salinity sensors provides background measurements but no ferrofluid catalyst result.
